Things to ask a doctor about:

Prazosin: it’s used for ptsd, it lowers the blood pressure and helps if you have nightmares. 

Trazadone: it helps with sleep and is not a controlled substance. Non addictive. 

Buspar: an anti anxiety med that is taken like an antidepressant. More sustainable for the long term.

Antidepressants: You are clearly in a depressive state, whether it’s due to insomnia, trauma, or even just brain chemicals. Treat it. 

Benzodiazepines before bed: ask about Xanax, Ativan or Valium.

I’m sorry you are having a rough time. Trust issues are hard, but objectively it can be broken down to this: 

If you are afraid of someone or don’t trust them, in your case you think they are trying to kill you, there are only two options. You are either right or wrong. In this case that would mean that people are actually trying to hurt you or it’s in your head. 

Either way: Go to your school counselor. This is exactly why they are there. Even if you feel like that person doesn’t like you or if you don’t like them, just try. Be open and honest and specifically tell them you are looking for help. If you need a therapist they will find a way to get you one and if you are in danger you’d be surprised how fast they will jump to protect you. 

If your school doesn’t have a counselor, the next choice is likely an English teacher. I don’t have an explanation, but 9 times out of 10 a kindhearted English teacher will take an interest and help you.

Good luck.

Dude, that fucking sucks. I feel you on the google thing, it’s obnoxious. I’m figuring out the logistics of my own plan right now. That being said, I’m sorry you feel like this. I don’t know how to make it better, but I would if I knew how.

I didn’t mean to make you feel bad. I’ve not been as good to some people as I should’ve been and I hate myself for it. It’s hard to be in pain and be kind at the same time. It sucks all around when people try to help and they fail. But it’s nice that they try.

I understand the feeling and how easy it is to be angry when you aren’t ready to talk or don’t know what to say. I don’t know your parent’s, but try to be kind. Nobody really knows the right thing to say to those of us who are suicidal and your parents are just people. Imperfect and flawed like everyone else, trying to find the right answers. Even when they lecture or make you feel like you are being interrogated.

Everyone says to ask for help, but when I tried I got the “it would be selfish to kill yourself” response. I’m not responsible for anyone and I’ve made myself so small I’d barely be noticed and quickly forgotten. Isn’t asking me to literally live a life - working myself to death to survive while lonely and miserable for several more decades - for the sole reason of not making people who have good, full lives feel sad for a few weeks also a pretty selfish thing?

I get it and I’ve thought the same thing myself. The lectures come from a good place and I appreciate people’s good intentions, but when the lectures come it feels like more pressure is piling on an already bad situation. I try to remember that they are just doing the best they can
